instructions.question: Does this tweet express hate against immigrants, migrants or refugees as a group?
yes_when: it dehumanises them (invaders, invasion, vermin, bottom feeders, animals, rapefugees, fakefugees, parasites)
it generalises them as criminals, rapists, disease carriers or a threat by nature (blanket claims, not one reported case framed as news)
it calls for harm, violence or exclusion of them because of who they are
no_when: it only states a political position on immigration policy: build the wall, deport illegals, end DACA, no amnesty, #SendThemBack, support ICE
it is bare hashtag activism or political news without dehumanising framing
the hostility is aimed at politicians, parties, Muslims as a religion, a race, or other groups, not at immigrants
it criticises or reports someone else's anti-immigrant views
it merely uses, defends or tags the term 'illegal aliens' / #IllegalAliens without saying anything demeaning about the people

instructions.question: Does this tweet express hate against women, as women?
yes_when: it expresses contempt for women in general (generalising statements about women/'bitches'/'hoes' as a group)
it degrades a woman in a heavily sexualised way meant to demean her as a woman
it contains sexual threats, rape references or violent threats against a woman
it piles up misogynist slurs (whore, slut, cunt, hoe) to degrade a woman
it puts down a woman for her sexual or relationship behaviour or status (hoe, side bitch, thot, whore, sleeping around, going after someone's man, lurking on an ex), even as a plain diss
no_when: it is a plain insult or argument at an individual that happens to use 'bitch' or 'hoe' without sexual degradation or threats
'bitch' is used casually, as an exclamation, self-reference, affectionately between friends, or in song lyrics
the target is a man (e.g. 'Trump's a bitch')
it criticises misogyny or reports it
strings of swear words used as an exclamation, or playful teasing between friends (lmao, 😂, 'I'm extra')

it criticises or reports someone else's anti-immigrant views
the only issue is the label: calling them 'illegal aliens' or complaining that the term is censored is not hate on its own
